design: Prespecified 20 chains per method, one second per chain, one worker, 1500 separate warmup iterations and full map-fitting budgets. Repeat v3 with fit seed 43 and chain seed 902001.
limits: Short local checks, not full-paper evidence or a universal algorithm ranking.
Before/after changes fitting, step calibration and execution together; it does not separately identify each change's effect.
Each run is conditional on one fitted ball and sphere map. Two fits do not quantify all fitting variability.
Equal acceptance targets need not be equally optimal; actual acceptance is recorded.
Program compilation fields exclude some initial runtime setup; total invocation wall time includes that work.

ball.note: Original VI clips its CDF argument to [-35,35]. Production density is unclipped.

sphere.objective: author reverse KL; target and Jacobian evaluated at clipped physical coordinates
sphere.target_note: Original DCS target; differs from the SCS paper Student-t-CDF skew target
